Population.evidence_source: Interviews were used to collect narrative data to explore the experiences of individuals bereaved by suicide.

Type.evidence_source: Interviews were used to collect narrative data to explore the experiences of individuals bereaved by suicide.

Area.evidence_source: Narrative inquiry methods provide the opportunity for participants to tell their story, which has been identified as a potentially cathartic process (East, Jackson, O'Brien, & Peters, 2010). Further, listening to their stories attributes value to participants (Frank, 1995). As suicide has been described as a traumatic and stigmatised event for survivors (Fielden, 2003; Mitchell et al., 2004) who are often ill-equipped to seek assistance in navigating their grief (Cerel & Campbell, 2008; Fielden, 2003), narrative inquiry was considered as an appropriate design to guide this research.
